Keep your home feeling clean between visits

Practical home-care notes · 4 minute read

PRO CLEANING / CARE IN EVERY DETAIL

Make room for a ten-minute reset

Put away the items that gathered during the day. Clear worktops and give high-use surfaces a quick wipe.

Catch dirt at the door

Use a doormat and consider a shoes-off routine. Vacuum busy entryways more often than quieter rooms.

Give each room a small routine

Dry the shower after use, deal with kitchen spills promptly, and keep a small basket for items that belong elsewhere.

Make your next visit easier

Share any priorities and put away valuables or delicate items. Clear floors let the cleaner focus on cleaning rather than reorganising.
